english_meaning: of the great mantra, the divine hymn of a thousand names
Amṛtāṃśūdbhava, from whom the moon arose
Nandakī, wielder of the sword Nandaka
Rathāṅgapāṇi, with the discus in his hand
Trisāmā, praised by the three Sāmans
Śrī Viśvarūpa, whose form is the universe
for the pleasure of Śrī Mahā-Vishnu
in the recitation of the Sahasranāma hymn
